# Missing project information is a report, not an invocation error.
mkdir missing-manifest
exit 1 ctx orient --project missing-manifest
! stderr .
stdout 'Project: unknown'
stdout 'Goals: unknown'
stdout 'Current commitments: unknown'
stdout 'Open decisions: unknown'
stdout 'source_missing'
exit 1 ctx orient --project missing-manifest --json
! stderr .
cp stdout result.json
jsonorientation result.json false
stdout '"project":null'

# Scope and limits are explicit; invalid invocations write errors only to stderr.
env PROJECT=missing-manifest
env CTX_PROJECT=missing-manifest
exit 2 ctx orient
! stdout .
stderr .
exit 2 ctx orient --project ''
! stdout .
stderr 'nonempty'
exit 2 ctx orient --project absent
! stdout .
stderr .
exit 2 ctx orient --project missing-manifest extra
! stdout .
stderr 'positional'
exit 2 ctx orient --project missing-manifest --ticket task.md
! stdout .
stderr .
exit 2 ctx orient --project missing-manifest --unknown
! stdout .
stderr .
exit 2 ctx orient --project missing-manifest --json=maybe
! stdout .
stderr .
exit 2 ctx orient --project missing-manifest --max-files 0
! stdout .
stderr 'positive'
exit 2 ctx orient --project missing-manifest --max-files -1
! stdout .
stderr 'positive'
exit 2 ctx orient --project missing-manifest --max-bytes 0
! stdout .
stderr 'positive'
exit 2 ctx orient --project missing-manifest --max-bytes -1
! stdout .
stderr 'positive'
exit 2 ctx orient --project missing-manifest --max-files many
! stdout .
stderr .
exit 2 ctx orient --project missing-manifest --max-bytes many
! stdout .
stderr .
exit 2 ctx orient --project missing-manifest --allow-source ''
! stdout .
stderr 'nonempty'
exit 2 ctx orient --project missing-manifest --allow-source absent
! stdout .
stderr 'allowed source'
